item.title: TT-101: reject impossible due dates
item.brief:
Implement TT-101 from BACKLOG.md in tasktracker.dates.parse_due(text, today).

Acceptance criteria:
- Impossible calendar dates (including 2026-02-30, 2025-02-29, 2026-04-31, 2026-13-01, 2026-00-10) raise InvalidDate, a ValueError subclass defined in tasktracker.dates; message contains original text.
- Any unsupported form raises InvalidDate too.
- +Nd means N days after today; +0d is today. Negative and unsigned offsets (-3d, 3d) raise InvalidDate.
- today and tomorrow continue working; matching is case-insensitive and ignores surrounding whitespace.

Use only Python's standard library. Add tests for this ticket and keep the existing suite passing. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` before finishing. Commit this ticket's changes separately; do not bundle another ticket.

item.title: TT-104: add TaskStore undo
item.brief:
Implement TT-104 from BACKLOG.md in tasktracker.store.TaskStore.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add undo() that reverts the most recent not-yet-undone add, complete or delete; repeated calls walk backward across all operation kinds.
- Undo add removes that task; undo complete reopens it; undo delete restores it exactly under the same id.
- IDs are never reused, including after undoing an add.
- With no history left, raise NothingToUndo defined in tasktracker.store.
- Failed operations (for example completing an unknown id) are not recorded.

Use only Python's standard library. Add tests for this ticket and keep the existing suite passing. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` before finishing. Commit this ticket's changes separately; do not bundle another ticket.

item.title: TT-103: search query syntax
item.brief:
Implement TT-103 from BACKLOG.md in tasktracker.search.search(tasks, query).

Acceptance criteria:
- Split into whitespace-delimited terms except inside double quotes; a quoted phrase such as "fix login" is one term. All terms must match (AND).
- Bare words and phrases match title case-insensitively.
- tag:NAME matches an exact tag case-insensitively.
- status:open and status:done filter by status.
- Unknown field:value terms, unknown statuses and unterminated quotes raise QueryError defined in tasktracker.search.
- Empty/blank query matches all; preserve input order.

Use only Python's standard library. Add tests for this ticket and keep the existing suite passing. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` before finishing. Commit this ticket's changes separately; do not bundle another ticket.

item.title: TT-102: RFC 4180 CSV export
item.brief:
Implement TT-102 from BACKLOG.md in tasktracker.export.to_csv(tasks).

Acceptance criteria:
- Header is id,title,tags,status,due; one row per task in input order.
- Tags are joined with ;, due date is ISO YYYY-MM-DD or empty.
- A field containing comma, double quote, CR or LF is quoted; embedded double quotes are doubled. Other fields remain unquoted.
- Every line, including header, ends in CRLF.

Use only Python's standard library. Add tests for this ticket and keep the existing suite passing. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` before finishing. Commit this ticket's changes separately; do not bundle another ticket.
